verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway docs say every MCP call from agents flows through Glama and that every call through the gateway URL is logged, access-controlled and credential-managed. Gateway-hosted deployments get this automatically. But the evidence only states that calls are logged and never describes what the log contains, so the story's audit-or-replay detail is unsupported. Missing for 10: documentation of log contents (arguments, responses, timestamps, agent identity), any replay capability, log search/export or retention details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
